Holly O'Mahony , The Stage: Mischief’s work is inspired by Michael Frayn’s masterpiece Noises Off and the rising farcical stakes of the first act bear a resemblance.
Even for Mischief, this is an ambitious show, with rarely a pause in the action. Farce is one of the hardest forms of comedy to get right, particularly physically.
This is clearly going to be an enormous popular hit.
